question.title: Hulls a Gap Apart
question.content:
A shipyard records the length of each hull in an integer array hulls. Two hulls can share a slipway when their lengths differ by exactly gap.

Return the indices of two different hulls that can share a slipway, as an array of length 2. If several pairs qualify, return any of them, with the two indices in any order. The input guarantees that at least one pair exists.

 

Example 1:

Input: hulls = [14,17,11,20], gap = 3
Output: [0,1]
Explanation: Hulls 14 and 17 differ by 3. Indices 0 and 2, or 1 and 3, would also be accepted.

Example 2:

Input: hulls = [5,2,11,8], gap = 6
Output: [0,2]

Example 3:

Input: hulls = [7,7,12,12], gap = 5
Output: [0,2]

 

Constraints:

  • 2 <= hulls.length <= 1000
  • 1 <= hulls[i] <= 104
  • 1 <= gap <= 104
